name: change-set-spec-delta
body: The diff of the durable spec (`apg/layers/**`) between the merge-base of the project branch with the repo's default branch and the branch tip, expressed as added, removed, or re-pointed `implemented-by` code FQNs, added or removed solution nodes, and added or changed requirements. Its base is the merge-base of the project branch with the default branch. When the default branch carries no spec, the whole branch spec is the delta. It is the durable-spec analogue of the plan's transient task list.
